name: TELECOMUNICACIONES DEL CATATUMBO
notes:
INTERCATATUMBO (AS273001) is a regional Internet Service Provider operated by TELECOMUNICACIONES DEL CATATUMBO S.A.S., based in Cúcuta, Norte de Santander, Colombia.

We provide residential and business Internet connectivity through fiber-optic and wireless infrastructure across northeastern Colombia.

Our network operates its own IPv4 and IPv6 address space and maintains a regional backbone connecting Cúcuta, Tibú, La Gabarra, Campo Dos, and Puerto Lleras.

We operate a multihomed BGP network and welcome peering opportunities with content providers, CDNs, Internet Exchanges, and other network operators.

We support IPv4 and IPv6 interconnection, subject to technical feasibility and mutual agreement.

For peering requests, please contact us through the designated PeeringDB contacts.
